```lean
theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h1 : b ≥ 3 := hb
  have h2 : a > b := ha
  have h3 : a * b = 12 := h
  have h4 : b = 3 := by
    have h5 : b ≤ 3 := le_of_not_gt h1
    have h6 : b ≥ 3 := h1
    exact eq_of_le_and_ge h5 h6
  subst h4
  have h7 : a * 3 = 12 := h3
  have h8 : a = 4 := by rw [h7]; exact div_eq_of_mul_eq h7 (lt_iff_lt_right 3).1 h1
  exact h8
```
